teyvatcartographia.settings.path.tooltip: The path to the tracked pin on the world map, for every kind of pin at once. All settings set it for each kind separately.
teyvatcartographia.config.title: Teyvat Cartographia settings
teyvatcartographia.config.theme.tooltip: Colours, icons and Fog of War of the map, the minimap and the menus. Other themes come with their resource packs.
Square or round minimap, whatever the look of the rest of the interface.
teyvatcartographia.config.interface_styl: Rectangular: flat panels, buttons and tiles with square corners. Rounded: circles, capsules and rounded corners.
teyvatcartographia.config.map_zoom.toolt: Zoom the world map opens with.
teyvatcartographia.config.map_labels.too: Biome names on the world map.
teyvatcartographia.config.map_grid.toolt: Chunk and region borders on the world map: regions from zoom 1/8, chunks from 2.
teyvatcartographia.config.minimap_orient: North up: the map stays still. Rotate with view: the map turns with you and shows E, S and W too.
teyvatcartographia.config.minimap_rate.t: Redraws per second while you move. Lower gives more FPS.
teyvatcartographia.config.minimap_offset: Distance from the side of the screen.
Distance from the top or bottom of the screen.
teyvatcartographia.config.minimap_paddin: Gap between the frame and the map inside it.
teyvatcartographia.config.minimap_fade_w: How much of the radius fades out towards the frame. 0%: a sharp edge.
teyvatcartographia.config.minimap_fade_s: How transparent the very edge of the map gets. 100%: it fades out completely, 0%: no fading.
teyvatcartographia.config.minimap_info_g: Distance from the minimap to the lines under it (coordinates, biome, clock and day) and between those lines.
teyvatcartographia.config.minimap_text_s: Size of the lines under the minimap and of the N, E, S, W on it, in screen pixels per pixel of the font, so it stays sharp. Auto: one step smaller than the interface (2 at GUI scale 3).
teyvatcartographia.config.minimap_pill_o: How opaque the background of the lines under the minimap is. 0%: text only.
teyvatcartographia.config.minimap_time.t: A clock under the minimap: game time, your computer's time, or both side by side (game time on the left).
teyvatcartographia.config.minimap_time_s: Game time, your computer's time, or both side by side (game time on the left).
teyvatcartographia.config.minimap_time_f: How the clock writes the time, game and real: 24-hour (14:35), 12-hour (2:35) or 12-hour with AM/PM (2:35 PM). Available while the clock is on.
teyvatcartographia.config.minimap_day.to: The day of the world under the minimap, together with the game time when the clock shows it.
teyvatcartographia.config.pins.custom.to: Demon, quest, star, meat, flower, pickaxe and hook pins. Map: on the world map; both maps: also on the minimap; in the world: also the marker over a tracked one; everywhere: also its beam of light.
teyvatcartographia.config.pins.interacti: Sign, party and structure pins. Map: on the world map; both maps: also on the minimap; in the world: also the marker over a tracked one; everywhere: also its beam of light.
teyvatcartographia.config.pins.system.to: World spawn and last death. Map: on the world map; both maps: also on the minimap; in the world: also the marker over a tracked one; everywhere: also its beam of light.
teyvatcartographia.config.pins.map.toolt: Show these pins on the world map.
teyvatcartographia.config.pins.minimap.t: Show these pins on the minimap.
teyvatcartographia.config.pins.marker.to: The marker over the tracked pin: its icon and the distance.
teyvatcartographia.config.pins.beam.tool: A beam of light over the tracked pin.
teyvatcartographia.config.path.custom.to: The path to a tracked custom pin. Map: on the world map; both maps: also on the minimap; everywhere: also the stars in the world.
teyvatcartographia.config.path.interacti: The path to a tracked interactive pin. Map: on the world map; both maps: also on the minimap; everywhere: also the stars in the world.
teyvatcartographia.config.path.system.to: The path to a tracked system pin. Map: on the world map; both maps: also on the minimap; everywhere: also the stars in the world.
teyvatcartographia.config.path_route.too: On land: the path walks round deep water and swims across it only where it is narrow (up to 16 blocks) or there is no other way. Across water: it goes by boat across deep water of any width. Either way the stretches over water are drawn in the colour of the sea.
teyvatcartographia.config.path.map.toolt: The path as a line on the world map.
teyvatcartographia.config.path.minimap.t: The path as a line on the minimap.
teyvatcartographia.config.path.world.too: The path as stars on the ground. The pulse key shows them again.
teyvatcartographia.config.detail.tooltip: Low: flat colours. Medium: shaded slopes. High: also contour lines.
teyvatcartographia.config.caves.tooltip: Map the caves around you while underground.
teyvatcartographia.config.player_cone.to: The cone of light the player arrow looks along and the glow under it, on the world map and the minimap. Off: the arrow alone.
teyvatcartographia.config.plants.tooltip: Plants colour their spot on the map. The arrow opens the list of every plant of the game and your mods: switch off the ones to leave out (all are on at first). A solid plant switched off shows the ground under it. Places already mapped change when you pass by again.
teyvatcartographia.config.scan_radius.to: How far around you the map is drawn, in chunks.
teyvatcartographia.config.chunks_per_tic: More fills the map faster but costs more FPS.
teyvatcartographia.config.max_tiles.tool: Map regions kept in memory. More uses more RAM.
teyvatcartographia.config.water_depth.to: How much deeper water gets darker. 0%: all water the same colour.
How much of the ground shows through shallow water, less the deeper it is. 0%: off.
teyvatcartographia.config.compat.nether_: Unexplored parts of The Nether are smoke with embers. Off: the usual Fog of War.
teyvatcartographia.config.compat.end_fog: Unexplored parts of The End are a starry void with a nebula, and the islands cast a shadow on it. Off: the usual Fog of War.
teyvatcartographia.config.compat.aether_: Unexplored parts of The Aether are a sea of clouds, and the islands cast a shadow on it. Off: the usual Fog of War.
teyvatcartographia.config.compat.sift_fo: Unexplored parts of The Sift are a haze in the colours of its ichor. Off: the usual Fog of War.
teyvatcartographia.config.preview.small: The preview does not fit at this interface size.
teyvatcartographia.config.preview.small_: Lower the GUI scale in the game's options to see it.
teyvatcartographia.config.preview.no_wor: Open them in a world to see it.
teyvatcartographia.config.compat.sift_ic: The ichor shimmers on the map in its own colours. Off: the average colour of its texture. Places already mapped change when you pass by again.
teyvatcartographia.config.compat.sift_sn: The ichor snow shimmers on the map in its own colours. Off: the average colour of its texture. Places already mapped change when you pass by again.
teyvatcartographia.config.compat.xaero_t: The custom pin type the imported waypoints get.
teyvatcartographia.config.compat.xaero_h: Import the waypoints that are switched off in Xaero's Minimap too.
teyvatcartographia.config.compat.xaero_d: Import Xaero's Minimap death points too, named "Death point".
